The term represents the entire sacrificial system that Christ's once-for-all sacrifice supersedes. Spanish 'holocaustos' and French 'holocauste' preserve the Greek term meaning 'wholly burnt.'"

  Sense 1: ""

Mark 12:33 contrasts love with all burnt offerings. Hebrews 10:6, 8 (quoting Psalm 40) declare God's displeasure with mere ritual burnt offerings, pointing to Christ's superior sacrifice. The Greek ὁλοκαύτωμα literally means 'wholly burnt,' from ὅλος (whole) + καί...
